tagline: 理光胶片相机，2000 年发布
description: 理光于2000年推出的胶片相机。配备Ricoh 28-70mm zoom. Max. aperture f/5.6-10. Five elements in four groups.。快门速度1-1/250s.。使用Auto-load, wind and rewind. Mid-roll rewind also available.。感光度ISO 100/400 via DX Encoding.。

specs.镜头: Ricoh 28-70mm zoom. Max. aperture f/5.6-10. Five elements in four groups.
specs.闪光灯: Automatic system for correct power. Operating range at 28mm focal length is 0.9-2.5m at ISO 100. 1.2-1.4m at 70mm. Six second recharge.
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto-load, wind and rewind. Mid-roll rewind also available.
specs.英文简介: The RZ-728, introduced in December 2000 by Ricoh, was a compact Zoom lensed camera, marketed as a pocketable travel companion thanks to its wide-angle range.
